lines: 15:35:46  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Chris): You are standing at eight of twenty in the room where six people have died. The thing that killed all six of them is in here with you, and not one of them looked at it before they swung. Try that. Look at the troll — read what comes back, all of it. Then drink, or swing, or go back south. All three are real answers. One of them is wrong.

items.text: Let it be — the player who prayed at 15:35 got my answer, stood there fourteen minutes, and departed; the world is empty again and there's no one for a voice to land on.
